story: I bought a washing machine for Rs 32,000 from an electronics store in Nagpur on 5 August 2026. It stopped spinning after two weeks. The store says the warranty does not cover it and the company has not sent a technician despite three complaints.
An airline cancelled my flight from Mumbai to Delhi on 1 October 2026 without notice and has not refunded the Rs 9,800 fare even after a month.
I want to see the attendance register and salary records of the teachers at the government school in my village in Satara district for the year 2025-26.
I filed an RTI application with the district collector office in Jaipur on 10 August 2026 asking for land records. It has been more than 30 days and I have received no reply.
My neighbour attacked me with a stick yesterday in Lucknow over a parking dispute and I have bruises on my arm. I want to file a police complaint.
Someone has been calling my sister repeatedly and threatening to kill her if she does not pay him Rs 50,000. We live in Bengaluru.
I got a link on WhatsApp for a part-time job, they asked me to pay Rs 15,000 as a registration fee by UPI and then blocked me. I am in Hyderabad.
Someone created a fake Instagram account with my photos and name and is messaging my friends asking for money.
मैंने ऑनलाइन एक फ्रिज मंगवाया था, 25,000 रुपये दिए, लेकिन टूटा हुआ फ्रिज आया और कंपनी रिफंड नहीं दे रही। मैं भोपाल में रहता हूं।
माझ्या भावाला काल रात्री कोणीतरी मारहाण केली आणि त्याचा मोबाईल हिसकावून नेला. आम्ही पुण्यात राहतो.
My brother and I are fighting over how to divide our late father's house in Kolhapur.
My landlord is not returning my security deposit of Rs 40,000 after I vacated the flat.
